svg.text: My cover started on 7 July 2025 and I saw the
consultant on 4 January 2026, more than six
months later. So HLH-021 shouldn't have been
declined for the waiting period, should it?
If your cover began on 7 July 2025, then 4
January 2026 was day 181, the plan’s waiting
period ends on day 181, and cover starts on
So from what date would I have been covered?
If your cover began on 7 July 2025, the
waiting period ended on 4 January 2026, so you
would have been covered for treatment from 5
January 2026, subject to the plan’s usual
limits. Check your cover start date ...
Yes. You can appeal the declined claim through
the member portal, I can’t change the decision
